item.tib: gsas mkhar gsang ba sgo dgu'i sgrub pa las phyi g.yen khams skong ba'i 'phyong
item.coloph: ces gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs kyi nang nas/ a dkar theg pa chen po'i grol phug(phugs) gsas mkhar spyi dril gsang ba sgo dgu'i sgrub pa la(las/)snang srid g.yen khams skong ba'i thar cha 'di yang / 'chi med rig 'dzin gshen gsum gyi lung donaM/ gshen chen gsang ba 'dus pa'i thugs bcud/ dbal gshen stag la nyid kyis mdzad srol/ bla chen dran pa nam mkha'i brnags pa/ stang chen dmu tsha gyer med kyi smar byang / mkhas pa de nyid kyis byang phyogs gsang ba'i brag la grub pa bsnyes nas/ shin tu zab par gzigs nas gter ni gsang ba'i brag la sbas so/ man ngag ni stong (stang) chen gyi thugs la gab po/ phyis su rten 'brel legs pa'i dbu brnyes nas/ skabs su bab pa'i kho bo bdag la dngos grub bab pa 'di yang / mtshan ldan bla ma'i gsung gis bskul ba la brten nas/ stang chen dmu tsha'i bka' yi bdag snyid/ 7sprul sku blo ldan snying po'i rjes 'jug 'gro mgon tshe dbang rig 'dzin gyi snying bu/ u0f38tshe dbang bde chen snying po'am 7g.yung drung thogs med rtsal du 'bod pa bdag gis/ stang chen dmu tsha nyid kyi zhal lung bzhin du yi ger btab pa'o//
